params.b: coefficient list of the same length

cd_scale.doc: Scale a coefficient list by a real number.

cd_norm2.doc: Return the squared norm of a coefficient list.

cd_norm.doc: Return the norm of a coefficient list.

cd_inv.returns: the inverse, or None for a zero divisor or the zero element

z_function_complex.returns: the Hardy Z-function Z(t), a real number

params.N: number of terms; 0 uses the Riemann-Siegel truncation
params.s: the point s as coefficients; None uses ½ + it

z_function_hypercomplex.returns: dict with Z_L, Z_R and their difference

params.t_min: lower end of the t range
params.t_max: upper end of the t range
params.n_primes: number of primes in the Euler-product test
params.perturb: value placed in e₂..e_{dim−1}; zero is the pure ℂ embedding, nonzero activates the ZD-sensitive directions

scan_zeros.returns: dict with the series, ordering and definer zeros found

params.t_min: lower end of the t range
params.t_max: upper end of the t range
params.eps_dir: perturbation size ε along each ZD direction

scan_zd_aligned.returns: one dict per ZD direction, with its ordering-minimum t and the nearest known zero

main.doc: Command-line entry point: run the hypercomplex zeta scan for the chosen dimension.
